label: E004AN DeviceMFT module watcher
args: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $end=(Get-Date).AddSeconds(20); $seen=@{}; Write-Output ('E004AN_WATCH_BEGIN '+(Get-Date -Format o)); while((Get-Date)-lt $end){ foreach($p in Get-Process){ try { foreach($m in $p.Modules){ if($m.ModuleName -ieq 'QcDeviceMFT8380.dll'){ $k=$p.Id.ToString()+'|'+$m.BaseAddress.ToInt64().ToString('x'); if(-not $seen.ContainsKey($k)){ $seen[$k]=1; Write-Output ('E004AN_DMFT_LOAD time={0} pid={1} proc={2} base=0x{3:x} path={4} exe={5}' -f (Get-Date -Format o),$p.Id,$p.ProcessName,$m.BaseAddress.ToInt64(),$m.FileName,$p.Path) } } } } catch{} }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }; Write-Output ('E004AN_WATCH_END '+(Get-Date -Format o))
